input.quote: Each Party represents and warrants to the other Party that (1) it is a corporation organized, validly existing and in goodstanding under the laws of the state of its incorporation;
input.rationale: Section 9 contains only corporate existence, authority and no-conflict representations; there is no warranty that the Site will be developed, hosted or maintained to any standard, no conformance warranty and no remedy (the only performance protection is the 70-day launch termination right in Section 1.6). We added a workmanlike-performance, conformance (12 months), compliance-with-law and no-malicious-code warranty with re-performance, repair/replacement or refund as our remedy. There is no disclaimer to carve out.

The Agreement contains no insurance covenant, yet HDI hosts our consumer-facing Site on its own servers and processes our customer and order data. We inserted a short Section 10.9 with our baseline limits (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M while HDI processes our customer data, workers' compensation as required by law) and certificates on request.
